name: Academic Speaking Sessions (Live Online) for AKU Students

content.title: Academic Speaking Sessions (Live Online) for AKU Students
content.summary: ELE_net offered AKU students the opportunity to improve Academic Speaking Skills by participating in live classes conducted on the Zoom platform.

media.alt: Academic Speaking Sessions (Live Online) for AKU Students

content.text: In April, ELE_net offered AKU Students the opportunity to improve their Academic Speaking Skills by participating in live classes conducted on the Zoom platform. Students who enrolled for these weekly sessions came from different AKU programmes and campuses, including Pakistan, Tanzania and Kenya. Each 90-minute session supported students in developing their academic language through a range of interactive online activities and engaging discussions.

Students showed a lot of enthusiasm in the sessions and their eagerness to develop English language skills was commendable. They particularly enjoyed working with their group members in the Zoom breakout rooms where they felt engaged and motivated.

ELE_net received very positive feedback from the students who really valued the experience. Building on this success, ELE_net is planning to offer more live online sessions in 2020. We encourage you all to adapt and evolve with us as we continue to succeed in delivering virtual classes and sharing knowledge during this challenging time of quarantine and social distancing.
